subject: Engineering Graphics
notes: No chapter-level learning outcomes are given.
Dimensioning and conventions strictly as per SP 46:2003 (Revised).

chapters.name: Introduction
topics: Capital and small letters and numerals in standard proportions
Unidirectional and aligned dimensioning as per SP 46:2003

chapters.name: Lines, Angles and Rectilinear Figures
topics: Construction and division of lines and angles
Triangles, square, rhombus, regular pentagon and hexagon

chapters.name: Circles, Inscribing and Circumscribing of Circles
topics: Inscribing and circumscribing circles in triangle, square, rhombus, pentagon, hexagon

chapters.name: Introduction to Engineering Curves
topics: Ellipse, parabola, hyperbola, involute, helix, cycloids and sine curve: definition and applications

chapters.name: Orthographic Projection of Points and Lines
Orthographic Projection of Regular Plane Figures
topics: Triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon, circle, semicircle

chapters.name: Orthographic Projection of Right Regular Solids
topics: Cube, prisms and pyramids, cone, cylinder, sphere, hemisphere, frustums
Axis perpendicular to HP/VP or parallel to both

chapters.name: Section of Solids
topics: Sections of cubes, prisms, pyramids, cones, cylinders and spheres by a vertical cutting plane

chapters.name: Orthographic Projections of Simple Machine Blocks
topics: Orthographic projection of simple machine blocks

chapters.name: Isometric Projection of Laminae
topics: Isometric scale (10 mm main, 1 mm minor divisions)
Isometric projection of regular plane figures parallel to HP or VP
notes: Isometric view of plane figures (full size scale) is for internal assessment only.
